pricing_reality.title: Investment & Procurement Reality
pricing_reality.headline: The Problem with Rigid Quotes in Government IT
pricing_reality.description: Government IT procurement demands transparency and strict adherence to official public contracting frameworks. Relying on opaque flat-rate bids frequently results in budget overruns, compliance risks, and project friction.
pricing_reality.disclaimer_text: We operate exclusively on compliant public service contracts without hidden licensing obligations. We ensure absolute cost transparency by providing rigorous effort estimations prior to any commitments.

seoText.title: Specialized Digital Solutions for Government Agencies
seoText.content: Transforming civic infrastructure demands uncompromising data protection, barrier-free access adhering to BITV 2.0, and complete technological independence. We partner with state and municipal entities to craft seamless, citizen-focused digital workflows that align perfectly with the Online Access Act (OZG). Our bespoke engineering practices ensure full alignment with federal IT procurement frameworks, while our deployments on ISO 27001-audited systems safeguard sensitive public information without exception.
